svg.title: AIcoach — Upload (verdict first)
svg.text: Upload — The coach asks for one clip. The checklist is its message; the composer is the drop zone.

text.tspan: Ready when you are. Send me one swing, filmed down the
line — from behind you, along the target line. Before you

svg.text: Behind you, along the target line.
On or parallel to the hands line.
On a stand or your bag, not handheld.
Head to clubhead, the whole swing.
Trim it to one swing, max 15 s.
Drop the clip below when you have it. I only keep it if you ask me to.

text.tspan: · mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing

svg.text: Off by default. If on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Your answer opens as one verdict. You can ask the coach about it after.
Analysing — Progress streams in as a coach message. The verdict slot on the right fills only when the rule table has decided.

text.tspan: asked for one down-the-line clip · checklist
Got it — a clean down-the-line clip at 120 fps. Watching it
now; this takes under a minute.

svg.text: checks early extension, loss of posture, over the top
You can ask about the result when it’s ready.

text.tspan: The fault name and confidence appear only after the rule
table has decided. Nothing is guessed early.
